build_pedestal_model: build a fake pedestal model that returns fixed pedestal values for testing
build_runtime_params: build runtime parameters for the pedestal model from a pydantic config at a given time
register_pedestal_model: register a pydantic pedestal model config class with the pedestal package
test_fake_pedestal_model: test the fake pedestal model by running a torax simulation with the registered config
run_simulation: run a torax simulation using a ToraxConfig created from a dictionary with a fake pedestal model
